stories.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, locations, distance, duration) to ensure contract consistency across layers.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials service into EvaluateCareFacade to orchestrate query execution, distance enrichment, and response formatting for tool consumption.

stories.title: Tool Router Exposure for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowlisted tool via tool_router with validated inputs and structured outputs for LLM tool-use execution.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Service
stories.description: Implement unit tests for query building, location extraction, and distance calculation, plus integration tests covering end-to-end flow through facade and tool router.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing test file for clinical_trials_service; must create new tests under backend/tests/
